name: erika
description: Erika（絵里香）——为你的仓库绘制肖像的画师少女 / A banner girl who paints portraits for your repos

scripts.render:mas: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js render --template grokbot --data packages/templates/extracted/mas/data.json --preset Moemu/Muika-After-Story --icon packages/templates/assets/muika-icon.webp --out out/mas.webp
scripts.render:rikka: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js render --template grokbot --data packages/templates/extracted/rikka/data.json --preset Moemu/Nonebot-Plugin-Rikka --icon packages/templates/assets/rikka-icon.webp --out out/rikka.webp
